```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Faker\Factory as Faker;

class ExpenseSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run()
    {
        // Create a Faker instance
        $faker = Faker::create();

        // Seed 100 expense records
        for ($i = 1; $i <= 100; $i++) {
            // Generate expense data
            $expenseData = [
                'user_id' => fake()->numberBetween(1, 50), // Assuming there are 50 users
                'category_id' => fake()->numberBetween(1, 10), // Assuming there are 10 categories
                'amount' => fake()->numberBetween(10, 1000), // Random amount between 10 and 1000
                'description' => fake()->sentence(5), // Random description
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ];

            // Insert the expense record
            \App\Models\Expense::create($expenseData);
        }
    }
}
```
